name: Clipboard History
author: Raj Shimpi
description: Remembers what you copy, text and images, for 24 hours (or as long as you like) and keeps it one click away in the bar: search it, copy it back, type it into any window, and pin what you want to keep. Password-manager copies are never stored, and nothing leaves your computer.

barWidget.description: Search, copy back, type and pin what you copied
